description: This file contains Vue.js component utilities and functions for mounting, updating, and unmounting Vue components within a testing or runtime environment, specifically tailored for Playwright testing framework integration.

methods.name: isObjectComponent
methods.description: Type guard to check if a component is an ObjectComponent based on __pw_type property.

methods.name: isJsxComponent
methods.description: Type guard to check if a component is a JsxComponent based on __pw_type property.

methods.name: __pwCreateChild
methods.description: Recursively creates Vue nodes or wrappers from JSX or object components.

methods.name: __pwCreateSlot
methods.description: Creates a Vue slot function from HTML string, used for slot compilation.

methods.name: __pwSlotToFunction
methods.description: Converts slot string or array into a slot function.

methods.name: __pwJsxChildArray
methods.description: Extracts children array from JSX component props.

methods.name: __pwCreateComponent
methods.description: Creates a Vue component configuration object from a custom component structure.

methods.name: __pwWrapFunctions
methods.description: Wraps slot functions into Vue-compatible render functions.

methods.name: __pwCreateWrapper
methods.description: Creates a Vue VNode wrapper for a component, attaching listeners.

methods.name: __pwSetDevTools
methods.description: Sets up Vue devtools hook for component event emission.

methods.name: playwrightMount
methods.description: Mounts a Vue component into a DOM element, with hooks support.

methods.name: playwrightUnmount
methods.description: Unmounts a Vue component from a DOM element.

methods.name: playwrightUpdate
methods.description: Updates the mounted Vue component with new props, slots, and listeners.
